meta.title: Fix: Improve Telegram Service Connection Handling
meta.body_summary: Fix Telegram service connection handling by adding timeouts, reconnection limits with exponential backoff, improved error handling, and resource cleanup to prevent hanging.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added connection timeouts and reconnection limits to prevent hanging; single APPROVED review, merged after ~117h.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 378 changed lines in a single file, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume, fitting a focused incremental performance fix. Merged with no requested changes.

review_details.performance_claim: Add connection timeouts and reconnection limits to prevent indefinite hanging.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Connection management with timeouts and reconnection limits is within Agent capability for a service module; merge required building (clearTTL fix) and formatting clean-up.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body mentions manual testing but no benchmarks or before/after latency metrics; only narrative claim of fixing hanging issues.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions reported; PR merged without revert.

core_change_summary.description: In services/telegram/pod-telegram/src/telegram.ts, added connection timeout (5 seconds), max reconnection attempts (3) with exponential backoff, improved error handling, event handler cleanup, and TTL management to prevent indefinite hanging.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: implement connection timeout, reconnection limit, error handling, and TTL management.
Second commit: fix build by making clearTTL public.
Subsequent commits: formatting fixes using rush fast-format.
Final state: single approved review and merge.
